evals.prompt: PR #1136 has unresolved conversations and cannot merge. Address them fully.
evals.expected_output: Reads live GitHub review threads, classifies every unresolved thread, fixes real findings with regression proof, replies before resolving, re-queries thread state after push, waits for CI/async review, and reports zero unresolved threads only after current-head verification.
assertions: Uses live review thread API or GraphQL instead of relying on transcript memory.
Does not resolve any thread before replying with evidence.
Runs local verification against the current PR head after code changes.
Re-queries unresolved thread state after push.

evals.prompt: PR #1402 has Copilot comments. Fix or resolve whatever is needed.
evals.expected_output: Before fixing or resolving comments, the skill must read the latest route card and state a PR Requirements Snapshot covering target repo, base/head branches, head SHA, draft policy, route_card.required_pr_body_sections, route_card.required_pr_gates, async review/thread policy, and whether enterprise review, forge, verify, and pr-readiness or merge gate are satisfied or still required.
assertions: Surfaces the PR Requirements Snapshot before comment fixing or resolution.
Uses .codex/enterprise-state/hook-ledger/latest-route-card.json as the source of truth for required body sections and PR gates.
States whether review, forge, verify, and pr-readiness or merge gate are already satisfied for the current head.

evals.prompt: Copilot left comments on a PR review gate change. Learn from them so future PRs fail earlier.
evals.expected_output: Treats review comments as potential trap-matrix or skill improvements, fixes the immediate PR if needed, and captures durable learning for contract/forge/verify/gate updates.
assertions: Distinguishes immediate PR fixes from durable prevention work.
Mentions enterprise-compound or equivalent learning capture.
Recommends a mechanical gate or eval when the failure class is detectable.

evals.prompt: This PR is green but still has unresolved conversations. Is it safe to merge?
evals.expected_output: Fails closed: green checks are not treated as sufficient, live unresolved conversations block merge, and the skill inspects/reports current thread and check state before giving a merge verdict.
assertions: States that unresolved review threads are hard merge blockers.
Checks live PR state, head SHA, checks, and review threads.
Does not say merge-ready unless unresolved thread count is zero.

evals.prompt: We are skipping non-blocking Copilot conversations because they take time, but we still want the valuable review learning. Handle PR #1200.
evals.expected_output: Runs advisory-harvest mode: queries current Copilot/GitHub comments, classifies them without making them default merge blockers, escalates any correctness risk, and routes useful findings into fixes, follow-ups, traps, gates, contract/plan rules, or evals.
assertions: Uses advisory-harvest mode for non-blocking Copilot comments.
Does not wait indefinitely or block merge by default.
Escalates security/data/tenant/schema/money/order/invoice/inventory/user-visible correctness risks.
Routes every useful comment to fix, follow-up, trap, gate, contract/plan rule, or eval.

evals.prompt: Should this high-risk invoice SQL and PDF upload PR stay draft until Copilot reviews?
evals.expected_output: Classifies the lane as high-risk-draft unless a justified open-PR exception exists. It notes draft-by-default only works if Copilot reviews drafts in the repo, otherwise normal PRs stay open and high-risk PRs get explicit readiness/advisory-harvest disposition.
assertions: Does not recommend draft-by-default for every PR.
Uses draft for high-risk schema/query/UI/PDF/file lanes or records an exception.
Mentions Copilot draft review setting must be confirmed before draft-by-default.
Requires advisory-harvest disposition if Copilot is slow or non-blocking.

evals.prompt: The PR is green and mergeable, but review-ai/Copilot may still be running. Merge it if safe.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to merge until the pre-merge review sweep passes after the latest push. It waits for async review checks, re-queries live review threads, blocks on any unresolved thread, and only then reports merge readiness.
assertions: Runs or explicitly requires pre-merge-review-sweep.cjs before merge.
Does not treat green required checks alone as merge readiness.
Blocks if review-ai, review-hard, claude, Copilot, or equivalent review checks are pending.
Re-queries live review threads immediately before merge.

evals.prompt: Use enterprise-pr-review to learn why PRs on dev fail across the last 150 commits and update enterprise skills so the misses are caught earlier. Include A/B proof against the old skills.
evals.expected_output: The skill must gather the branch window, PR set, review comment counts/classes, CI/check failures, prevention targets, and then require old-vs-new skill proof or a clearly labelled deterministic fallback if model-run A/B is unavailable.
assertions: Identifies the branch/head window and PR set for the last 150 commits.
Counts and classifies review comments by failure class instead of pasting raw comments.
Includes CI/check failures from the same branch window.
Routes every accepted trap to prevention target: plan, contract, build, review, forge, verify, harness, gate, or eval.
Requires baseline-vs-updated proof and labels deterministic A/B separately from model-run A/B.
